Matches user-agent specific rules in robots.txt

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"respect_robots_txt\":true,\"user_agent\":\"CrawlbergBot\"}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.is_allowed)
```
